property_summary: For any validly signed short-put order, fillOrder must complete and return the taker's own position id — uint256(hashOppositeOrder(order)) — whose owner is the caller and whose positionExpirations is set to block.timestamp + duration; the mutant returns/mints the maker's already-minted orderHash id, so it reverts (ALREADY_MINTED) and never returns the taker's position id for any caller distinct from the maker.
change_summary: Replace `positionId = uint256(oppositeOrderHash);` with `positionId = uint256(orderHash);` so fillOrder returns the maker's position id instead of the taker's.
